events.verdict: Harris (LAC) sets the pick on Matthews (DAL) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Bradley (LAC) reflexively places his arms around Jordan's (DAL) midsection as the pick is set before correcting.
Gallinari (LAC) beats Barnes (DAL) to the spot and maintains a legal guarding position as Barnes initiates contact at the end of the drive.
Matthews (DAL) places his hand to Harrell's (LAC) opposite side as the pick is set and makes contact that is tactile in nature.
Jordan (DAL) establishes himself in a screening position in Gallinari's (LAC) defensive path and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Gallinari (LAC) makes slight contact with Matthews (DAL) as the screen is set, but does not affect his FOM as they move toward the perimeter.
Matthews (DAL) firms up in his screening position in Gallinari's (LAC) defensive path and absorbs contact as it is made.
Jordan (DAL) sets the pick on Gallinari (LAC) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Jordan (DAL) slightly extends his forearm against Harrell's (LAC) backside as the shot is released, but does not affect his ability to retrieve the rebound.
Harrell (LAC) moves into Jordan's (DAL) body during the rebound and creates contact that gives him the leverage to dislodge the ball.
Harrell (LAC) is already in Matthews' (DAL) defensive path as slight contact takes place, which does not affect Matthews' ability to defend.
Matthews (DAL) makes incidental foot contact with Williams (LAC) that does not affect his SQBR.
Matthews (DAL) makes marginal contact with Gallinari (LAC) at the top of the perimeter.
[Observable in enhanced video] Gallinari (LAC) slides his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Doncic (DAL) cleanly intercepts the pass intended for Williams (LAC).
LLB shows Bradley (LAC) makes clean contact with the ball after Doncic's (DAL) gather.
Matthews (DAL) commits the take foul on Williams (LAC) in the back-court.
Matthews (DAL) wraps Williams (LAC) off-ball and affects his FOM.
Barnes (DAL) and Harris (LAC) engage and disengage off-ball without affecting the other's FOM.
Barnes (DAL) commits the take foul on Harris (LAC) after the inbound.
Doncic (DAL) places, but does not fully extend, his left hand against Bradley's (LAC) front during the dribble.
Bradley (LAC) makes marginal contact with Doncic's (DAL) front along the perimeter that does not affect his SQBR.
Barnes (DAL) commits the take foul on Harris (LAC) after the inbound.
Harris (LAC) makes incidental body contact with Jordan (DAL) during the inbound.
